measured_facts.statement: Error code E-204: Lubrication pressure low.
Drive-end bearing temperature is 91.4 C against a normal range of 55-75 C (z = 4.82, alarm band).
Vibration RMS is 8.1 mm/s against a normal range of 0-4.5 mm/s (z = 5.40, alarm band).

manual_instructions.step: De-energize the motor and apply lockout/tagout before removing the coupling guard.
Inspect the lubrication line and verify pressure gauge reading at test port TP-2.

inspection_checklist.action: Apply LOTO to the motor starter and verify zero-energy state.
inspection_checklist.expected_observation: Zero voltage measured across all line and load terminals.
inspection_checklist.if_abnormal_then: Stop immediately. Escalate to qualified plant electrician.

inspection_checklist.action: Inspect drive-end bearing housing for oil discolouration or leaks.
inspection_checklist.expected_observation: Clean oil level within sight glass indicators without foaming.
inspection_checklist.if_abnormal_then: Sample oil for particulate contamination and check filter differential.

inspection_checklist.action: Verify lubrication delivery pressure at test port TP-2 using a calibrated gauge.
inspection_checklist.expected_observation: Lube oil pressure between 2.2 and 2.8 bar under priming cycle.
inspection_checklist.if_abnormal_then: Inspect auxiliary lube pump and clean suction strainer.

hypotheses.cause: Drive-end bearing lubrication starvation leading to elevated thermal stress and vibration.
hypotheses.discriminating_check: Verify oil delivery pressure at test port TP-2 and inspect oil filter differential.
